title: Retrospective data analysis of the influence on hand function before and after hand rehabilitation
summary: In order to better evaluate the results of existing hand therapy rehabilitation measures and the significance of future diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, data from hand therapy rehabilitation is analyzed.
conditions: Joint stiffness, not classified elsewhere: unspecified location
Other and unspecified injuries of wrist and hand

interventions.name:
Retrospective Analysis of Data,
non-interventional study,
Evaluation of existing data from hand rehabilitation programme

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All Patients who participated special handtherapeutic rehabilitation in 2015, 2016 or 2017 for at least three weeks.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with functional impairment of both hands,
Patients whose rehabilitation period exceeds the turn of the year 2014/2015 or 2017/2018
